scope: Actual desktop UI observation of one representative live work after the size correction. All ten pages and thirty assets have separate complete live readbacks. All thirteen selected sources and ten final openings were reviewed separately. Mobile and physical-device AR were not exercised.
observations: Visible upright font assembly retains the original captured surface and all four narrative sides; the Angels face has the documented darker texture.
Orbit drag changed the view to the reverse; rotation was paused and Reset restored the approved Baptism opening.
The live AR/VR label and object record show Dimensions unknown with a chosen default of 1 m on the longest side, with no claim that a panel height sizes the whole font.
The object record identifies the four original plaster models as one font assembly, qualified model dates, unknown whole-assembly dimensions and uncalibrated physical size.
All four museum component records, immutable source provenance, Geoffrey Marchal attribution and CC BY4.0 scan rights are present.
